description.narrative: Goal: - To strengthen the capacity of District Agriculture and Environment Office staff (Policy Dissemination Units), local authorities, farmer groups, women, and youth. - To support relevant organizations (Policy Dissemination Units) in disseminating the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy to local organizations, community leaders, farmers, women, and youth. - To strengthen communities' understanding of various policies issued by the district, provincial, and central levels. Objectives: - Topromote cooperation among civil society organizations, government sectors, and local organizations in recognizing the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy. - To strengthen the capacity of relevant sectors (Policy Dissemination Units) regarding thenew Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy and other policies. - To promote and develop the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy. Outcomes: - Project participants from associations, relevant government sectors (District Agriculture and EnvironmentOffices, specifically Policy Dissemination Units) will become stronger units with increased skills, knowledge, and access to various policies. They will be able to represent thedistrict in disseminating the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy to their government counterparts over the long term. They will also be able to establish new CSA policy dissemination teams and further disseminate knowledge about the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy to local organizations, strengthening those organizations. - Representatives of local organizations will be able to represent their groups by applying their skills and knowledge of the CSA policy to disseminate and raise awareness among communities, youth, women, and farmers within villages. These community members will understand and recognize the importance of the new Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) policy. They will be able to apply this knowledge to their agricultural work amidst the changing climate conditions, thereby increasing the efficiency of their agricultural production, enhancing their income sources, and ensuring household food security.

participating-org.narrative: The vision of the Rural of Development Livelihood Association (ROLA) is to contribute to the well-being of society by improving thequality of life to the community, providing access to quality education, and providing heath care with equal opportunities. This mission focuses on the principles of sustainable agriculture and environmental management, as well as promoting healthy nutrition. Mission-Objective of the Rural of Development Livelihood Association(ROLA): To improve the lives of target group anddisadvantaged people living in rural areas. To achieve this goal: their skill must be developed, access to education must be supported, nutrition must be promoted, and effective agricultural and environmental management.
